title: Build record is trusted
statement: A build record is trusted when the digest of its canonical bytes equals a digest that verified provenance supplies.

title: Image signature is acceptable
statement: An image signature is acceptable when it is in the transparency log or made by a trusted key, and its signer identity is the trusted signer the ci-pipeline component names for the provider that built the image.

title: Digest is superseded
statement: A component digest is superseded when its lifecycle holds a supersession.

title: Digest is past its fail date
statement: A component digest is past its fail date when its lifecycle holds a supersession or a withdrawal, and the date after which it fails has passed.

title: Digest is withdrawn
statement: A component digest is withdrawn when its lifecycle holds a withdrawal, whatever the date of the withdrawal.

title: Requirement is met
statement: A platform requirement is met when the environment file supplies, under its name, a value of its kind with every part its shape names, such as each key of a secret or the port of an egress endpoint.

title: Reference is pinned
statement: A pipeline reference is pinned when it names a full 40-character commit SHA or a sha256 OCI digest.

title: Fill is qualified
statement: A fill is qualified when its evidence names its current content digest and its slot contract's current digest, and a key in the project's SIGNERS file signed that evidence.

title: Fill fits its binding
statement: A fill fits a slot binding when it implements the bound slot and serves the bound collection.

title: Generated file is hand-edited
statement: A generated file is hand-edited when the file on disk is missing or no longer matches the hash its record holds.

title: Component fit for a golden path
statement: A component is fit for a golden path when its stage is ga. An archetype or a mixin MUST NOT include a component that is not.

title: Port has one provider
statement: A port has one provider when exactly one component of the active component set provides it. Each port MUST have one provider in the active set.

title: Every required port is answered
statement: An active component set answers its ports when every port that a component of the set requires has a provider in that set.

title: Component past its sunset
statement: A component is past its sunset when its stage is alpha or beta and its sunset date is earlier than today.

title: Component states its place
statement: A component states its place when it names one layer, its part in a request flow, and a side for each port it provides or requires.
